svg.title: How to read a box
svg.desc: Two box plots of the same 100 tracks on one logarithmic axis. The boxes, medians and dots are the same. With Fence set to Raw values the lower whisker runs to the floor and the upper whisker is short. With Fence set to Axis space the two whiskers are much closer in length.
